name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 12, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of $30,000 Donation for a Concert Grand Piano by Encinitas Friends of the Arts
4B.
Presentation of Proclamation to the Ecke family in honor of Elizabeth (Jinx) Ecke
4C.
Presentation of $10,000 Donation for the Community Grant Program by the Ecke Family
4D.
Presentation by San Diego County Fair representative Amy Laufenberg
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the May 15, 2019 Joint Special Meeting Minutes and the May 15, 2019 Regular Meeting Minutes. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-06-12 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-06-12 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Appointment to the Parks and Recreation Commission and Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy on each commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Mayor's recommendation to appoint David Warren to the Parks and Recreation Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2020; and to appoint Mona Angel to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2021.
2019-06-12 Item 08C REDACTED Unscheduled Vacancy Appointments - Parks & Recreation and Senior Citizen Commissions
8D.
Environmental Systems Research Institute (ESRI) Enterprise License Agreement (ELA) for GIS software and applications. Contact Person: IT Applications Supervisor VanPelt
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute the three-year ESRI Enterprise License Agreement for GIS software and applications, in the not to exceed amount of $50,000 for each fiscal year of the life of the contract, totaling $150,000, allowing for continuity of service with ESRI.
2019-06-12 Item 08D ESRI Enterprise License Agreement (ELA) for GIS software
8E.
Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan Outcomes for Fiscal Year 2018-19 and Proposed Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2019-20. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
1) Receive final report outcomes for the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2019-20 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan.
2019-06-12 Item 08E Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan Outcomes for Fiscal Year 2018-19 and Proposed Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2019-20
8F.
Commission for the Arts Work Plan Outcomes for FY 2018-2019 and Proposed Work Plan for FY 2019-2020. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
1) Receive the Final Report Outcomes for FY 2018-2019 Commission for the Arts Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2019-2020 Commission for the Arts Work Plan.
2019-06-12 Item 08F Commission for the Arts Work Plan Outcomes for FY 2018-2019 and Proposed Work Plan for FY 2019-2020
8G.
Notice of Completion for the Citywide Storm Drain Repair FY17-18 Project (CD05E). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Direct staff to release the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Direct staff to file the Notice of Completion.
2019-06-12 Item 08G Citywide Storm Drain Repair FY 17-18 Notice of Completion
8H.
Ratify the legislative position letter in opposition to AB 1356 (Ting). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letter in opposition of AB 1356 signed by the Mayor.
2019-06-12 Item 08H Legislative Position Letter
8I.
Contract for Carpet Replacement at City of Encinitas Community Library and Public Works Facility. Contact Person Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract substantially as to form as attached with G&S Carpet Mills, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $219,230.
2019-06-12 Item 08I G&S Carpet Contract
8J.
Authorization to migrate data center disaster recovery to a hosted model. Contact Person: IT Operations Manager Contreras
1) Approve migrating the City’s data center disaster recovery and authorize the implementation of Option 1, as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report; and 2) Authorize hosted disaster recovery with iLand in an amount of $29,057 in FY 2019-20; and authorize anticipated subscriptions in the amount of $25,068 in FY 2020-21, for a total of $54,125.
2019-06-12 Item 08J Disaster Recovery Solution
8K.
Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan outcomes for FY 2018-19 and proposed work plan for FY 2019-20. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) Receive final report outcomes regarding the FY 2018-19 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2019-20 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan.
2019-06-12 Item 08K Parks & Recreation Commission Work Plan outcomes for FY 2018-19 and proposed work plan for FY 2019-20
8L.
Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group for the Standard Pacific Park Site. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
City Council authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney to execute an amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group in substantial form as attached to include additional design review, extend the term of the agreement through the end of the project, and additional permitting requirements for the Standard Pacific Park Site (Attachment 1 of the agenda report), based on the expansion of the project scope.
2019-06-12 Item 08L Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group for the Standard Pacific Park Site
8M.
Approval of Carol Wolf for membership in the Urban Forestry Advisory Committee and establish Committee membership at seven members. Contact Person: Mayor Blakespear
Approve Carol Wolf for membership in the Urban Forest Advisory Committee and establish Committee membership at seven members.
2019-06-12 Item 08M REDACTED Appointment to the UFAC
8N.
Revised Establishment Document for the Encina Wastewater Authority as Amended. Contact Person: Director of Public Works Quiram
Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Revised Establishment Document for the Encina Wastewater Authority (EWA) as Revised (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2019-06-12 Item 08N Revised Establishment Document for EWA
8O.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2019-06-12 Item 08O Mobility Projects and Grants Update
8P.
Sign and sign hardware contract. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract substantially to form as attached with Hi-Way Safety in an amount not to exceed $965,418.
2019-06-12 Item 08P Signs and Signs Hardware Contract Agenda Report
8Q.
Amendment of the existing authorization amount for Citywide Street Light Maintenance and Repair Services with Clark Telecom Electric, Inc. (CTE) and ELLD budget adjustment request. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
1) Authorize the City Manager to increase the contract amount with Clark Telecom Electric, Inc. from $283,000 to $291,600 annually for an amount not to exceed the total contract cost of $583,200 for the remaining agreement term FY2018-19 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Authorize a budget amendment to increase the FY2018-19 operating budget for street light maintenance by $8,600 for the remainder of the term of the agreement for FY2018- 19. The cost of this increase is not anticipated to exceed $291,600 for the remaining year of the agreement; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-42 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2019-06-12 Item 08Q Streetlight Contract Amendment Agenda Report
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Approval of FY 2019-20 and FY 2020-21 Operating Budget and FY 2019-20 to FY 2024-25 Capital Improvement Program (CIP) and Financial Plan; Adoption of Resolution 2019-43 Approving Appropriations for FY 2019-20; Adoption of Resolution 2019-44, Determination of the Appropriations Limit for FY 2019-20; and Adoption of Resolution 2019-45 Approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for FY 2019-20. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-43, approving the City of Encinitas FY 2019-20 Operating Budget and CIP appropriations; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-44, determining the FY 2019-20 Appropriations Limit; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-45, approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for the City of Encinitas for FY 2019-20.
2019-06-12 Item 10A Approval of FY 2019-20 and FY 2020-21 Operating and CIP Budgets (Posted 06-08-19 1:52 P.M.)
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Information report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Initiated Item from Council Members Kranz and Mosca requesting the formation of a City Council subcommittee for the purpose of meeting with the three local public school districts (Encinitas Union School District (“EUSD”), Cardiff School District (“CSD”), and San Dieguito Union High School District (“SDUHSD”)) to explore options for the adoption of a school bus program and/or alternatives that will promote the following goals: (1) decreasing traffic congestion, (2) reducing greenhouse gas emissions and other harmful air pollutants, and (3) promoting active transportation.
2019-06-12 Item 12A Council Initiated Item from Council Members Kranz and Mosca - subcommittee for school transportation
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING POSSIBLE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2019-06-12 Item 14 Follow Up Log
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JUNE 19, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
